readings.moment: When the temple struck ten, Girard's watch showed four minutes to ten
Girard went out into the street
The piano started up in the salon as Girard lit his cigar
Girard heard faint quick bells from the master's window, twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch
The piano stopped, eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch
Girard came back into the house, fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch
The hall clock had just struck eleven
The hall clock's face showed two minutes past eleven

durations: Girard was in the street from 10:21 to 10:46 by his watch, about 25 minutes
The piano played from 10:29 to 10:42 by Girard's watch, about 13 minutes
The piano was playing all the while during the bells heard at 10:34, until it stopped at 10:42
whereabouts: Girard came to dinner at Monnier's because Monnier asked him
Girard quarrelled with Monnier about the price of the movement at the dinner table
After dinner Girard sat alone in the dining room with the brandy
Monnier had all the guests show their watches after dinner
Girard looked at his watch when the temple struck ten, while in the dining room
Girard went out into the street at 10:21 and stayed under the front windows of the house
Girard lit a cigar while in the street
Girard was in the street when the piano started and when the bells were heard
Girard could not say who was at the piano, because he was in the street and did not see it
Girard came back into the house at 10:46
Girard went upstairs to Félix in the library
Girard did not play cards with Dr Vauthier this evening
